returns.title: Extended Holiday Return Policy
returns.summary: All items purchased during our Black Friday & Cyber Week promotional period are eligible for free returns or exchanges until January 31, 2027.
conditions: Items must be unwashed, unworn, and undamaged with original brand tags attached.
Footwear must include the original undamaged shoebox placed inside an outer shipping carton.
Return shipping labels are 100% complimentary via our self-service returns portal.
Refunds are credited back to the original payment method within 3 to 5 business days of inspection.

shipping.title: Black Friday Shipping Timelines & Delivery
shipping.summary: Standard express delivery is 2-4 business days. Complimentary free express shipping is automatically applied to all orders over $75.
conditions: Orders placed before 2:00 PM EST ship the same business day from our fulfillment centers.
Primary domestic carrier partners include FedEx Priority and UPS Ground.
Holiday delivery guarantee: Place orders by December 18 for guaranteed arrival before Christmas.
Real-time SMS and email tracking links are dispatched immediately upon carrier scan.

price_match.title: Black Friday Price Match Guarantee
price_match.summary: If any item purchased between November 1 and December 5 drops in price on Cyber Monday or before December 25, we will refund the difference directly to your original payment method.
conditions: Applies to identical in-stock items (same style, color, and size).
Price adjustments can be requested online in one click via your order history or live chat concierge.
No store credit vouchers required; refunds are credited directly to your bank card.
Excludes limited doorbuster flash sales with inventory caps under 10 units.

discounts.title: Promotional Badges & Tiered Holiday Savings
discounts.summary: Save up to 60% off clearance bestsellers, plus an extra 10% instant discount automatically applied at checkout for orders over $150.
conditions: Discounts stack automatically with item-level clearance prices.
Threshold discounts ($150+) are computed based on the pre-tax, discounted subtotal.
Single-use VIP holiday coupons cannot be combined with clearance flash deals unless marked 'Stackable'.
Promo discounts apply immediately at checkout without manual code entry.

sizing_fit.title: Apparel Sizing & Exchange Assistance
sizing_fit.summary: We provide true-to-fit sizing specifications across all apparel categories from XS to XXL, with complimentary one-swap size exchanges.
conditions: If a purchased item does not fit comfortably, size swaps are free of charge with expedited cross-shipping.
Refer to the product detail modal for garment measurements (chest, waist, inseam).
Oversized silhouette items are marked with 'Relaxed Fit' badges in the catalog.

payment_security.title: Payment Options & Holiday Security
payment_security.summary: We accept all major credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and interest-free 4-installment payment plans with end-to-end 256-bit encryption.
conditions: Accepted cards: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover.
Split payment providers: Klarna and Afterpay available at checkout.
PCI-DSS Level 1 certified security with automated fraud prevention.
